8d73e4687d25f7c8.description: About Alsalam Aerospace Industries Alsalam Aerospace Industries, established in 1988, plays a key role in Saudi Arabia's strategy to achieve self-sufficiency in civil and military aircraft maintenance, overhaul, and modifications. This is achieved through technology transfer and the development of Saudi nationals. The company's vision is to lead the future of aviation, space, and defense, setting global standards while supporting the ambitions of Vision 2030. Its mission is to deliver high-quality aviation products and services that ensure exceptional customer satisfaction and long-term profitability. The Role of GSE Technician Alsalam Aerospace Industries is seeking a GSE Technician to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves working under an assigned management structure, reporting directly to the Site Superintendent. The GSE Technician is responsible for the comprehensive maintenance and troubleshooting of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and related support equipment. Key Responsibilities Perform repair, maintenance, servicing, inspection, and troubleshooting of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and associated support equipment. Determine GSE maintenance requirements, including inspecting parts, tolerances, fuel leaks, corrosion, tire wear, structural damage, cracks, and overall system performance. Utilize wiring diagrams, blueprints, schematics, technical manuals, and applicable technical orders to diagnose and resolve maintenance issues. Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain GSE systems and components such as engines, transmissions, gearboxes, instrumentation, hydraulic systems, basic electrical systems, heating systems, fuel systems, lubrication systems, cooling systems, gases, liquids, and associated servicing systems. Analyze equipment operating characteristics to identify sources of malfunction and determine appropriate repair procedures; perform operational checks, functional testing, fault isolation, and troubleshooting of GSE systems. Interpret and apply GSE maintenance and installation policies, procedures, technical manuals, and applicable maintenance instructions. Maintain, inspect, and calibrate GSE test equipment, and conduct detailed testing of repaired equipment using appropriate test equipment and diagnostic tools. Determine requirements for GSE maintenance activities, including tools, equipment, spare parts, consumables, and other maintenance resources. Supervisory and Training Duties Supervise GSE maintenance personnel and assist in planning and scheduling maintenance activities and work assignments. Ensure maintenance personnel understand and comply with applicable GSE maintenance procedures, safety requirements, technical directives, and maintenance standards. Maintain GSE technical publications, Technical Orders (TOs), maintenance records, training documentation, and applicable forms. Evaluate the job performance of GSE technicians and specialists regarding compliance with maintenance procedures, preventive maintenance requirements, technical instructions, and applicable standards. Conduct structured On-the-Job Training (OJT) for GSE trainees and personnel, covering equipment operation, scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, servicing, and safe working practices. Monitor trainee progress and provide practical guidance to support qualification and competency development, maintaining a recommended maximum trainer-to-trainee ratio of 1:3. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in GSE maintenance or a related field. Proficiency in using technical manuals, wiring diagrams, blueprints, and schematics for diagnostics and repair. Strong understanding of GSE systems and components, including mechanical, hydraulic, and basic electrical systems. Ability to conduct operational checks, functional testing, and fault isolation. Experience in supervising personnel and conducting on-the-job training is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring adherence to established management structures and reporting lines. The role involves hands-on maintenance work and supervisory responsibilities within a dynamic aviation support environment.

8d74ac65a12526e0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شذرات العالمية عن معلم ثانوي دراسات إسلامية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الثانوية في مجال الدراسات الإسلامية، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي للطلاب. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس الطلاب في مجال الدراسات الإسلامية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات. تنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية المتعلقة بالمنهج، وإدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الصف. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم تقدم الطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة بذلك. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين لضمان بيئة تعليمية متكاملة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريس الدراسات الإسلامية للمرحلة الثانوية. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتصميم المواد التعليمية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق تعليمي متخصص لدعم التنمية الأكاديمية والشخصية للطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

8d7e41c1505d4e15.description: Job Description: Finance Manager Job Title: Finance Manager Department: Finance Reports To: Chief Executive Officer Work Location: Head Office Supervises: Accounting, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payroll, Collections, and Financial Reporting Job Purpose To lead and manage the company’s financial and accounting activities, ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information, manage cash flow and budgets, strengthen financial controls, and provide reliable financial analysis to support senior management decision-making. Key Duties and Responsibilities Prepare the annual budget, financial forecasts, and long-term financial plans. Monitor actual financial performance against the approved budget and explain significant variances. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports. Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability, and financial performance by branch, department, and business activity. Analyze the financial performance of memberships, personal training, group classes, sports programs, and retail activities. Manage the company’s cash flow and ensure sufficient liquidity is available to meet payroll, supplier payments, and operational obligations. Prepare short-, medium-, and long-term cash flow forecasts. Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, collections, bank reconciliations, and general ledger activities. Monitor customer and supplier balances and ensure timely collection and payment of outstanding amounts. Review operating expenses and ensure compliance with approved budgets, policies, and delegated authority limits. Review purchasing transactions, contracts, and financial commitments before approval. Prepare branch profitability, break-even, contribution margin, and variance analysis reports. Monitor operating costs, cost of sales, inventory movements, wastage, adjustments, and stock valuation. Supervise periodic and annual inventory counts and reconcile physical inventory with financial and operational systems. Manage relationships with banks, financial institutions, payment providers, and point-of-sale service providers. Monitor loans, banking facilities, financing agreements, repayment schedules, and financial obligations. Review payroll, commissions, incentives, and bonuses in coordination with the Human Resources Department. Ensure compliance with VAT, Zakat, tax, and other financial and regulatory requirements. Coordinate with external auditors, consultants, banks, and government authorities. Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, internal controls, and approval authorities. Ensure proper integration between accounting systems, membership systems, point-of-sale systems, payroll systems, and inventory systems. Lead, supervise, and evaluate the performance of the finance team. Provide financial recommendations to senior management regarding cost reduction, revenue improvement, profitability, and operational efficiency. Prepare financial feasibility studies for new branches, expansions, investments, and major projects. Identify financial and operational risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Perform any other finance-related duties assigned by the Chief Executive Officer. Education And Professional Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. A master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration is preferred. A professional qualification is preferred, such as: SOCPA CMA CPA ACCA Required Experience Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in finance and accounting. At least 3 years of experience in a managerial or supervisory position. Experience in sports clubs, fitness, retail, hospitality, or multi-branch service businesses is preferred. Strong experience in budgeting, financial forecasting, cash flow management, and financial reporting. Experience dealing with banks, auditors, financing institutions, and government authorities. Good knowledge of Saudi Arabian tax, Zakat, and financial regulations. Required Skills Strong financial analysis and reporting skills. Ability to analyze income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Strong cash flow and working capital management skills. Budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling capabilities. Strong cost-control and expense-management skills. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting systems. Experience with ERP, point-of-sale, payroll, and inventory systems. Strong leadership and team-management skills. High level of accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Strong written and spoken English. Key Performance Indicators Accuracy of financial statements and management reports. Timely completion of monthly and annual financial closing. Cash availability and liquidity management. Budget compliance and variance control. Expense-to-revenue ratio. Gross profit margin and net profit margin. Accounts receivable collection rate. Supplier payment cycle. Payroll and commission accuracy. Reduction in accounting errors and unexplained adjustments. Internal and external audit results. Achievement of cost-saving targets. Accuracy of financial forecasts compared with actual results. Authority Review and approve financial transactions within the approved delegation of authority. Request financial documents, reports, and supporting information from all departments and branches. Reject or suspend financial transactions that are incomplete, unsupported, or non-compliant with company policy. Recommend changes to financial policies, budgets, controls, and procedures. Communicate with banks, auditors, and financial service providers as authorized by senior management. Evaluate finance team members and recommend recruitment, training, promotion, or disciplinary action. Working Relationships Internal: Chief Executive Officer, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Human Resources, Procurement, and Branch Management. External: Banks, external auditors, tax and Zakat authorities, suppliers, financing institutions, and payment service providers.

8d8a02dd88710bed.description: About the Role Welocalize is seeking an Arabic (Saudi Arabia) Multimedia Content Reviewer to join their team. This full-time role involves reviewing and writing linguistic content to ensure accuracy and cultural relevance for users of global multimedia platforms. This includes producing localized content and identifying potential cultural issues within content types and wording. The reviewer will articulate suggestions to ensure all content is appropriate and relevant for the target market, maintaining the highest quality standards. Write new copy for multimedia products, including music, TV, app store applications, video on-demand, and game subscription services. Conduct regular linguistic reviews of personal work and content produced by other localization team members. Copy-edit and fact-check content to ensure accuracy. Perform Localization QA (LQA) testing for content published on live platforms, such as music and app descriptions, marketing materials, and campaigns. Conduct market-specific research on local content treatment, product, terminology trends, and best localization practices for the target audience. Transcribe spoken content, including lyrics. Report on data and assets across a broad scope of media and content types. Review linguistic assessments, create training materials and documents for new projects, and ensure localization team counterparts are trained on terminology, style, and best practices. 8db2e8d52ba671d4.description: About the Role ZainTECH is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect – AWS (Presales) to join its KSA presales team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role serves as a senior technical lead, engaging directly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and other senior stakeholders across large enterprises and government organizations. The successful candidate will manage the technical lifecycle of AWS opportunities, from initial discovery and architecture through RFP/RFQ responses, commercial support, solution presentation, and handover to delivery. Key Responsibilities Own the technical solution for AWS opportunities from discovery through proposal and handover to delivery. Design secure, scalable, highly available AWS architectures across migration, modernization, networking, security, databases, containers, DR, data, and GenAI. Lead architecture discussions and technical decision-making with senior customer stakeholders. Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFQs, tenders, and customer requirements, including interpreting needs, identifying gaps, and developing solution narratives. Prepare Bills of Materials (BoMs), sizing, pricing inputs, and technical content, coordinating with AWS, partners, sales, and delivery teams. Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and solution presentations. Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and technical decision-makers, presenting complex AWS concepts clearly and challenging customer assumptions. Handle technical and commercial objections, including comparisons between AWS, Azure, Oracle, on-premises solutions, and cost concerns. Design AWS migration and modernization strategies, including VM migration, application modernization, and container adoption. Develop Amazon EKS and/or ECS architectures covering cluster design, networking, security, scalability, and CI/CD integration. Define Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, AWS CDK, and/or CloudFormation. Design resilient AWS architectures using multi-AZ and multi-region patterns aligned with business RTO/RPO requirements. Develop DR solutions using services such as AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery and AWS Backup, including various recovery approaches. Address KSA regulatory and compliance requirements, including NCA ECC/CCC, SAMA CSF, and PDPL considerations. Develop credible AWS cost estimates, TCO models, and DR cost-versus-RTO/RPO trade-offs for customer approval. Collaborate with AWS account teams, ZainTECH sales leaders, delivery engineers, and technology partners to develop and win opportunities. Leverage AWS partner programs such as Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), funding programs, and ACE co-sell. Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification, sizing, architecture assumptions, and cost models. Ensure successful transition of won opportunities from presales into delivery. Required Experience and Skills 8+ years of experience in a relevant field. Strong hands-on AWS architecture expertise. Commercial awareness and the ability to communicate complex technical solutions to executive audiences. Ability to challenge requirements and develop compelling business cases and TCO models. Experience addressing security and regulatory considerations. Proficiency in designing scalable AWS solutions across migration, modernization, containers, disaster recovery, data, and GenAI. Work Environment and Culture This role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position. ZainTECH fosters a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and integrity. Employees are expected to uphold the company's Code of Conduct, which guides responsible behavior in all interactions with colleagues, clients, and partners.

8d2425011799d980.description: About the Role A Leading Global Business School is seeking a freelance Education Photographer for a specialized two-day, on-site project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role supports the institution's refined brand identity, focusing on capturing the dynamic energy and diversity of its executive education programs. Role Objective The primary objective is to produce authentic, reportage-style photography that highlights transformational moments and the real-world impact of the learning experience. The imagery should place the viewer at the heart of the educational journey, moving beyond traditional classroom settings. Responsibilities Capture meaningful, candid moments of breakthrough insights and experiential learning from a participant's perspective. Utilize natural light to produce warm, inclusive, and authentic imagery that avoids an overly posed or staged appearance. Showcase a vibrant mix of gender, ethnicity, and nationality to accurately represent the global nature of the community. Mix wide environmental architectural shots with tighter interaction moments to convey emotion, energy, and connection. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided.

8d56be135099e34c.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع علاج الرواد الطبي عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من تقييم حالتهم الصحية وحتى توثيق الإجراءات الطبية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الأطباء ومعايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمرضى، وجمع البيانات منهم ومن ذويهم، ثم توثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمرضى وجمع عينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج. متابعة إرسال العينات إلى المختبر والحصول على النتائج وإبلاغ الطبيب المعالج بها. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج. المشاركة الفعالة في عمليات الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي بدقة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. تطوير الأداء يتوقع من أخصائي التمريض في هذا الدور العمل على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض. القدرة على إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات أخذ العلامات الحيوية والعينات المخبرية. الالتزام بالبروتوكولات الطبية وتعليمات الأطباء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجمع علاج الرواد الطبي في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى والتعاون مع الفريق الطبي لتقديم رعاية صحية متكاملة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

8da0d5ef40ee351f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان التشغيل الآمن والفعال للشاحنة الصغيرة، مع الالتزام بالمسارات المحددة ومعايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة وفقًا لخطط العمل والمسارات المحددة. الالتزام التام بجميع قواعد المرور، وإجراءات الأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب المخالفات النظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة الصغيرة لمعالجة أي مشكلات بسيطة قد تظهر. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للخبراء عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب فحصًا متخصصًا. الالتزام الصارم بأدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو مجال ذي صلة. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. المهارات المطلوبة الالتزام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. مهارات جيدة في الملاحظة والانتباه للتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في المدينة المنورة، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة والعمل وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

8da8e2eabcb9a077.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بن غره للمقاولات العامة عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة وتركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص وإصلاح الأعطال لضمان الأداء الأمثل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة عمليات تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية المخصصة للصيانة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات الميكانيكية ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم المخططات الفنية والكتيبات الخاصة بالمحركات. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال وإيجاد الحلول الفعالة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني ميكانيكي المحركات بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة بن غره للمقاولات العامة في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة تتبع أعلى معايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور متاح في جدة، مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كفني ميكانيكي محركات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

8dac31aef433d9d0.description: About Sanabil Studio and Revie Sanabil Studio operates as a venture builder, combining industry knowledge, technology, and startup methodologies to develop new businesses from initial concepts. When a venture demonstrates potential, it receives seed funding and operational support for scaling. The role involves supporting the planning, administration, and daily coordination of interior design and fit-out projects, ensuring efficient workflow and timely completion. Key Responsibilities Maintain project to-do lists, action trackers, and schedules, assigning clear ownership and deadlines for each task. Follow up with suppliers and internal operations, design, and sales teams regarding deliverables, approvals, material availability, and delivery dates. Assist the Project Manager with project planning, meeting arrangements, and daily coordination activities. Prepare meeting minutes, record action points, and track their completion. Organize project files, correspondence, reports, and supporting documentation. Senior designers will review work at every stage, fostering continuous learning and development within a fast-paced environment that emphasizes quality from concept to delivery.

This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on combining creative design with the execution of marketing activities. This full-time position is responsible for the planning, execution, coordination, and technical assurance of commissioning activities for Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) in utility-scale wind power projects. The role ensures that mechanical, electrical, control, protection, and grid-interface systems of WTGs are commissioned safely, operate reliably, and fully comply with OEM requirements, statutory regulations, and grid codes prior to handover. Key Responsibilities Review and provide inputs to the engineering team regarding engineering based on experience, grid compliance, WTG controller limits, and machine-specific challenges. Participate in FAT review of WTG control and protection systems where applicable. Develop WTG commissioning procedures, method statements, and risk assessments. Coordinate commissioning sequence planning with EPC, OEM, and grid operator. Supervise and verify the correct completion of mechanical erection, torquing, alignment, lubrication, and electrical installation (LV, MV, transformers, grounding systems). Ensure readiness of auxiliary systems including pitch and yaw drives, hydraulic and lubrication systems, and emergency and service power supplies. Lead pre-energization checks such as insulation resistance tests, grounding continuity, phase sequence, and voltage checks. Coordinate transformer energization and LV/MV energization, execute first grid synchronization, and progressive power ramp-up. Ensure safety compliance during live tests and rotating machinery operation. Validate WTG controller parameters as per grid code and PPC philosophy. Coordinate LVRT/HVRT, frequency ride-through, and reactive capability tests. Verify pitch-based power regulation and ramp-rate control, and confirm correct response to curtailment, trip, and fault conditions. Support trial run, availability tests, and performance acceptance. Review SCADA data, alarms, and event logs. Close commissioning punch points and support COD documentation. Conduct knowledge transfer and basic training for O&M teams. Testing and Troubleshooting This role is responsible for commissioning and grid-compliance testing of wind turbine generators according to IEC 61400-1, IEC 61400-21-1, IEC 61400-25, IEC 61400-27-1, IEC 60204-1, UL 6141, and other relevant standards. Key Commissioning Tests Insulation and dielectric testing of generators and transformers. Protection relay testing (OV/UV, OF/UF, differential, earth fault). Functional testing of pitch, yaw, mechanical brake, emergency stops, and fail-safe systems. Power curve and performance checks. Communication tests with plant SCADA and PPC. Key Troubleshooting Scope Grid-related trips (voltage/frequency instability). Pitch or yaw control faults. Excessive vibration or temperature alarms. Transformer or converter faults. Communication failures between WTG and PPC. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in wind turbine testing and commissioning.
